approval_note: Approved by the owner via the parent session. The owner enabled all remaining tasks ("Proceed with all remaining tasks!", 2026-10-21) after the strong correction that no certification may be claimed for a non-existent integration. The approval covers the implementation of the tasks in this spec.

scope_notes.split_reason: proxy-codex-memory is at its owner-approved shrink-only ceiling, and the combined commercial + model-policy contract does not fit one spec's budget (.kiro/steering/delivery.md). The model-control half therefore lives here, next to .kiro/specs/proxy-memory-commercial/.
scope_notes.dependency: Every end-to-end case in this spec needs the roles registered, so .kiro/specs/proxy-memory-commercial/ Requirement 1 (slice A) must land first: today the background phases are rejected before the backend is opened, so no model-control case has a subject.
scope_notes.budget_ownership: This spec adds a composition-root file to an affected surface. The Requirement 11.5 convergence headroom and the 'Proxy memory' overlay cap are accounted for in design.md; any deepenings that exceed the measured headroom go to the owner as a separate budget approval, and no budget marker is widened to hide a delta.

approved_scope.scope: All remaining tasks of this spec: the per-phase backend/model/reasoning-effort control, the per-phase allowed inventory and per-field locks, the enforcement against the final compiled actual target, the owner-scoped override store with its authenticated resource, and the freeze of the effective settings per claimed job.
approved_scope.parent_context: Strong correction: do not certify a non-existent integration. No further routine approval pauses. Authorizes ALL commercial + model contract scope, not merges/closures/new billing engine. The parent approved all three flags and ready_for_implementation in both copied specs.
approved_scope.excluded: Outside the original broad hand-down scope: merges and issue closures, a new billing engine or ledger, new money arithmetic, any certification of the frozen billing-financial-safety-contracts spec, and any request-supplied account or unverified marker treated as financial authority. The Enterprise tree may reuse the existing monetary host integration and financial policy; the open-source tree keeps ports, call sites and no-op defaults and never imports enterprise/.
approved_scope.notes: Base for implementation: 0b2d339ee, which carries the inherited unshipped memory feature and the archived runtime corrections (4e2d588fe, 0b2d339ee). A rebase onto main is not a precondition, and the land stays gated on the foundation reconciliation (#1287) and the owner merge authorization. Certification runs last, after the features are implemented; a required user-control guarantee that is not demonstrated blocks this slice readiness.
